difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the equivalence of four conditions for a groupoid in functors: smoothness of the groupoid, smoothness of its source map, smoothness of its target map, and smoothness of the quotient morphism (statement lines 6656-6666). The proof (proof lines 6668-6699) compares the source and target maps through the inverse morphism and translates between the two lifting conditions by unwinding the definitions and using the inverse. H2: two translations with two inputs, written out in full.
